Cascade layers organize declarations into explicitly ordered groups. Normal unlayered author
rules outrank normal layered author rules.
@layer වලින් CSS rules groups වලට Jබදෙලා priority පොලනය කරනවා. Normal rules සඳහා පෙසුව
define කළ layer එකට වුඩි priority තිJයනවා. Unlayered normal rules layers වලට වඩා ඉහළයි.
Important layer order එක reverse Jවනවා.
Override library defaults with component styles.
base layer: #title →red components layer: .title →blue · blue wins before specificity

Read the diagram: 1. Establish base then components. 2. Compare layers before specificity. 3. Later
normal layer wins here.
Normal base layer එකට වඩා components layer එJකේ priority වුඩි නිසා blue rule එක දිනනවා.

Expected result: Blue wins if element matches both rules in those author layers, with no other
override.
Interview question: Can a class selector in a later normal layer beat an ID in an earlier layer?
Answer: Yes, because layer priority is considered before specificity.
Practice: Move a normal override outside all layers and test it.
